precedence: Current 5.6-only policy overrides historical model text. This staged contract preserves existing repair scope, task, checkpoint and budgets. It grants no platform installation or production authority and is not a new dispatch spec for the old intake validator.

source_scope_purpose: Only current 5.6 default/allowlist/config admission and affected fixtures; preserve auth/sandbox/lease/epoch/fence/stop guards. Integrate three-file core delta semantically against actual UK base, never overwrite full local files or cherry-pick whole control branch.
manifest_scope: Recompute existing tracked install hash metadata as data only after runtime changes, no new install paths or installer execution.

budget.timeboxes: Planning targets from observed P0 start; do not expand original resource budget

actions: Read exact control source and bound existing authorizations
Reconcile actual B run/session/lease/fence/epoch and preserved counters
Resume original B if proven no live writer and native execution entry allows it; existing writer is reused
Persist and return bound actual RESUMED or precise HOLD in same run

stages.if_blocked: HOLD_WORK_EXECUTION_ENTRY_DISABLED with exact unavailable tool/policy/permission evidence; keep independent read-only preparation open

Prepare precise installed files/units/users/owners/modes/hash binding/rollback and backup restore commands

platform_evidence: root-owned verified broker binary and artifact hashes
persistent activation epoch/fence plus old Coordinator exclusivity

stages.rollback: Prepare hash-bound previous units/config/artifact and verified DB restore; preserve epoch monotonicity, stop and prove old cgroups empty, reconcile effects before reopening dispatcher. Never activate a historically failed release as rollback.
stages.acceptance: Actual controlled platform installation and host-bound boundary evidence; templates/unit tests are not acceptance

one bound APPROVE and one bound REJECT with identity/artifact/nonce/replay guards
new approved revision and duplicate delivery/document-only SHA/event storm/event while consumer active

acceptance_commands.notes: Execute only in trusted clean isolated candidate; verify interpreter against artifact contract, capture exit code/discovered test count/skips and full report. Do not force old248 count when new tests are added. Platform acceptance commands must be derived from actual frozen paths, binaries and units and independently reviewed before execution; exact host details currently NOT_RECEIVED.

result_transition.coordinator: Persist phase and immutable result before triggering next approved dependency; notification failure cannot erase completion
result_transition.work: Work can review while this run or an explicitly configured execution automation is active; PR comment alone does not prove a new Work run
result_transition.release_gate: FAIL remains until explicit artifact-bound corrective report; no timestamp/scratch override
